answer: Each identity binds one trade-union membership: 12 months of paid dues in the cedar dues ledger, union-signed, filed in the oasis registry, plus 30 POA bonded 90 days. Each extra fake needs a new union and a year of dues, so 100 fakes cost 3,000 POA in bonds plus 1,200 months of dues, and brokered memberships cost 70 POA each, doubling every 50 sold. A ridge cap of 40 attestations per union per epoch blocks bulk buys. Re-attestation is due within 72 hours; two misses halve the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. Unions lacking digital records pass on paper dues books plus doubled bond.
